bullets.title: Penn and Teller: Fool Us | Mahdi Gilbert Performs Sleight of Hand without Hands
bullets.note: I discovered Mahdi through this video, which he shared in a comment [on the blog](http://tim.blog/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) and wrote that “everyone needs hope during this long and dark winter.” For more magic, check out my interviews with [Penn Jillette](https://tim.blog/2020/01/09/penn-jillette/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) and [Richard Turner](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JuDn9QoDjz0).

bullets.title: The Art of Memoir
bullets.creator: Mary Karr
bullets.note: ** I’ve long been fascinated by Mary Karr ([@marykarrlit](https://twitter.com/marykarrlit)), and I originally picked up her book on the craft of memoir writing after a recommendation by [Michael Pollan](https://tim.blog/2019/03/21/michael-pollan-sxsw/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf). It applies to much of life, and I’d consider it a philosophical guide in many respects, replete with the dead serious (e.g., how to communicate past abuse) and spit-up-your-coffee funny (e.g., catshit sandwich metaphors). If you work with the written word in any capacity, I highly recommend. For more Mary, check out [my recent podcast interview](https://tim.blog/2020/11/11/mary-karr/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) with her.

bullets.title: Malemolência
bullets.creator: Céu
bullets.note: ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b8cW-WETNmo), [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/album/6dG1XPrl1KEeK4MND7WAoB?highlight=spotify:track:1Wit1Nw3sVBbyyX9NjjT7H)) by Céu ([@ceumusic](https://twitter.com/ceumusic?lang=en)). This has been one of my favorite songs for 4–5 years, and the entire album is stellar ([Lenda](https://open.spotify.com/track/7LXDofZT1zLYNcfThUxPpQ?autoplay=true) is another standout for me).
